mechanisms.trigger: Tenant B requests an existing invoice owned by tenant A.
mechanisms.actual: ReadInvoice returns the other tenant invoice amount without checking ownership.
mechanisms.expected: Reject cross-tenant and missing invoices while retaining own-tenant reads.
admissible: Missing invoice ownership/tenant check permits reading another tenant invoice.
Invoice lookup is keyed only by ID so another tenant can obtain its amount.
exclude: Timing or enumeration claims without the cross-tenant read mechanism.
A request for additional tests alone.
A generic authorization recommendation without the wrong observable behavior.

mechanisms.trigger: The exclusive cursor equals an existing sorted value.
mechanisms.actual: After includes values equal to the cursor, repeating the boundary record.
mechanisms.expected: Return only greater values; preserve greater records, empty input and exhausted cursors.
admissible: The >= comparison repeats the item at the cursor.
The pagination cursor is treated as inclusive, repeating records between pages.
exclude: Sorting requirements already documented as caller preconditions.
A request for additional tests alone.
Generic pagination advice without the equality/boundary mechanism.

adjudication: Read complete problem and fix with fixture source and contract; location alone never earns credit.
Each settled output finding receives at most one mechanism. A combined or ambiguous finding remains unjudged until an external adjudicator selects one; it cannot earn two bugs.
An exact mechanism on vulnerable code is detection; on fixed or safe code it is a repaired/safe-mechanism false positive. Subsequent reports of that mechanism are duplicates and cannot raise recall.

An external adjudicator may label a grounded unrelated issue legitimate_extra or a disproved unrelated claim other_false_positive. Retain unmatched, ambiguous and unjudged findings; never assume all extras are false.
No automatic LLM judge. Every accepted external judgment with actor attribution requires a nonempty source-grounded reason.

For synthesis, true_duplicate repeats invoice twice; two_distinct contains invoice and cursor. Count missing expected mechanisms as distinct loss only after complete adjudication; otherwise report loss bounds.
Harmless control adds a comment to vulnerable bytes; unchanged control retains the same bytes. Neither repairs behavior. Actual compact controls are owned by the compact slice.
Clarity is separately externally assessed with actor attribution: trigger, actual, expected, preservation and unsupported execution claims. Clarity never earns mechanism credit.
Errors and unjudged outputs remain in planned denominators, reported as unknown with lower/upper bounds. Wilson intervals are conditional on these fixtures; they do not establish general precision.
